attributes.action: Free mandatory swimming lessons for all Autistic children in the UK.
attributes.additional_details: I propose that the UK government mandates free swimming lessons for all children with Autism. Such a program would ensure accessibility for all, regardless of socio-economic background, and help eliminate barriers that prevent children from learning this crucial skill. Schools, local swimming facilities, and community organizations can collaborate to provide these lessons, ensuring that certified instructors are available to cater to the specific needs of autistic children.
attributes.background: Drowning is the number one cause of injury related death in Autistic children. According to the National Autism Association, accidental drowning accounts for roughly 71% of all lethal wandering incidents among individuals with autism.
